lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCuP2 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a 12-atom unit cell containing three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Cu centers coordinated by six P neighbors, Li centers by three P neighbors, and P centers by six neighbors (three Cu and three Li). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Cu- and Li-centered six-vertex coordination polyhedra.
